new_rows.label: Management responsibility versus physical controller location
new_rows.meaning: Identify the managing entity, the chassis it manages and the chassis where it is installed as separate relationships.
new_rows.loss: Independent management access does not identify the physical location of the managing entity.

new_rows.label: Physical enclosure versus logical chassis zone
new_rows.meaning: Record whether the chassis represents physical packaging or a logical zone; distinguish the enclosure relationship of a system from a parent chassis.
new_rows.loss: Attachment alone cannot represent membership in a logical zone or distinguish a system from its container.

new_rows.label: Supplying, consuming and hosting system instances
new_rows.meaning: Keep the direction of a supply-of-resources relationship; the separate HostingComputerSystem link identifies the host of a virtual computer system.
new_rows.loss: Visibility of composition members does not say which system supplies resources to which consumer or which system hosts it.

new_rows.label: Independent replacement and removal while operating
new_rows.meaning: Identify whether the vendor permits independent replacement and whether insertion or removal during operation is supported.
new_rows.loss: Knowing a part belongs to the asset says neither whether it is separately replaceable nor whether the equipment may keep operating.

new_rows.label: Assembly production, vendor and engineering change level
new_rows.meaning: Keep the producer and vendor roles, production time and engineering change level attached to the individual assembly.
new_rows.loss: A single manufacturer field loses the vendor role and member-level manufacturing pedigree.

new_rows.label: Installed cable and separately identified upstream and downstream endpoints
new_rows.meaning: Describe the cable as an identified piece of equipment, with endpoints and connector types at each end and its length.
new_rows.loss: A connector and its contact functions do not identify the cable joining two ports or which end is which.

new_rows.label: Redundancy group membership and minimum operating complement
new_rows.meaning: Record participating units, redundancy type, supported count and minimum count needed for the group.
new_rows.loss: An allowed component type or configured membership does not specify how many working members the group requires.

new_rows.label: Individual resource health and aggregate health including dependencies
new_rows.meaning: Preserve health of the resource in isolation separately from overall health seen at that resource, with condition records where supplied.
new_rows.loss: A health assessment with faults alone does not separate local condition from the contribution of dependencies.

new_rows.label: Sensor resource, source of an excerpt and equipment the reading describes
new_rows.meaning: Separate the source URI of a reading excerpt from the physical context and related equipment of the sensor. Establish the actual physical probe from additional evidence when necessary.
new_rows.loss: A subordinate capture selector cannot distinguish the source URI of an excerpt from the affected equipment.

new_rows.label: Absolute, delta or headroom basis of a reported reading
new_rows.meaning: State whether a reported quantity is relative to zero, a delta, or headroom. A common unit alone does not supply the reference.
new_rows.loss: Uncertainty qualifies the reading; it does not identify the reading’s reference basis.

new_rows.label: Physical, synthesized or externally reported sensor implementation
new_rows.meaning: Record how the sensor reading is produced and, when supplied, the sensor group contributing readings.
new_rows.loss: Simulated and substituted process signals do not express a reported sensor source or an aggregation group.

new_rows.label: Configured averaging interval and whether the available samples cover it
new_rows.meaning: Preserve the sample spacing, averaging duration and indication of whether sufficient samples cover that interval.
new_rows.loss: A scheduled report period does not establish the data coverage underlying its average.

new_rows.label: Sensor measurement range, equipment operating limits and environmental derating
new_rows.meaning: Distinguish what the sensor can measure from what its equipment may tolerate, including an adjusted limit under prevailing conditions.
new_rows.loss: Usable detection distance is a different limit and does not identify the subject of an operating constraint.

new_rows.label: Recorded minima, peaks and their timestamps
new_rows.meaning: Preserve the observed extreme value, its occurrence time and the reset context where supplied.
new_rows.loss: A current reading and its uncertainty cannot identify an earlier observed extreme or its time.

new_rows.label: Accumulated sensor reading and start of the accumulation interval
new_rows.meaning: Keep an accumulated quantity with the start of the accumulation interval for that sensor.
new_rows.loss: A pulse quantity and width do not identify when a cumulative reading started.

new_rows.label: Threshold crossing direction, dwell time and return hysteresis
new_rows.meaning: Keep the crossing criterion, duration required to activate, and value/time hysteresis used to deactivate.
new_rows.loss: A threshold value alone cannot explain why a condition has yet to activate or why it remains active.

new_rows.label: Control deadband and delay before activation
new_rows.meaning: Express how far the measured value may deviate from the set point and how long before the control acts.
new_rows.loss: A target and feedback association do not define the threshold or delay for acting on their difference.

new_rows.label: Control loop tuning coefficients and update time
new_rows.meaning: Identify proportional, integral and differential coefficients and the update time of those coefficients.
new_rows.loss: A sensor damping time constant describes a different operation from feedback-loop tuning.

new_rows.label: Automation node feedback, position, velocity and output roles
new_rows.meaning: Independently identify the node’s feedback sensor, position sensor, velocity sensor and output control.
new_rows.loss: A generic control/readback pair loses the different sensor roles in an automation loop.

new_rows.label: Metric report replacement, append limit, wrap and suppression of repeated values
new_rows.meaning: Record whether a new report replaces or appends, what happens at the append limit, and whether unchanged metrics are omitted.
new_rows.loss: Initial-cache selection does not tell a reader whether an older value was overwritten or a repeated value was suppressed.

new_rows.label: Accuracy of a metric timestamp separately from value accuracy and precision
new_rows.meaning: Qualify uncertainty in timing separately from numerical accuracy and the number of significant digits.
new_rows.loss: A value uncertainty does not place a bound on its timestamp.

new_rows.label: Metric sample linked to its resource property and metric definition
new_rows.meaning: Preserve the definition, supplying property, reported value and timestamp together for each metric report entry.
new_rows.loss: A named value lacks the source property and independently referenced definition that make it interpretable.

new_rows.label: Rated capacity, current maximum capacity and present stored charge or energy
new_rows.meaning: Keep rated, present maximum and currently stored quantities distinct. Ampere-hours and watt-hours have different dimensions.
new_rows.loss: A percentage of reserve does not supply the rated and actual maxima or their separate charge and energy bases.

new_rows.label: Battery health, discharge-cycle count and current charge
new_rows.meaning: Name state of health, accumulated discharge cycles and current percentage charge separately for the same battery.
new_rows.loss: A single remaining-life or capacity indicator cannot distinguish health from charge or quantify usage cycles.

new_rows.label: Per-cell voltage readings within a battery
new_rows.meaning: Preserve readings for the individual battery cells separately from voltage at the battery input.
new_rows.loss: A terminal voltage does not identify cell-level differences within the battery.

new_rows.label: Battery charge or discharge current normalized by rated charge capacity
new_rows.meaning: For the 2025.3 companion, compare current in amperes to rated capacity in ampere-hours. Retain this current-based normalization.
new_rows.loss: Input current alone cannot express a charge or discharge rate relative to rated capacity.

new_rows.label: Battery charge or discharge power normalized by rated energy capacity
new_rows.meaning: For the 2025.3 companion, compare power in watts to rated capacity in watt-hours. Retain this power-based normalization.
new_rows.loss: An active power measurement lacks the energy-capacity denominator.

new_rows.label: Power-supply efficiency at a specified percentage load
new_rows.meaning: Pair each efficiency rating with the load percentage at which it is specified.
new_rows.loss: A supply’s input/output envelope alone does not provide loading-dependent efficiency.

new_rows.label: Requested electrical-power allocation and actual allocated budget
new_rows.meaning: For a PowerSubsystem, preserve requested watts separately from allocated watts and identify the subject of the allocation.
new_rows.loss: A design envelope or measured consumption cannot establish a negotiated power budget.

new_rows.label: Quality of an AC electrical waveform
new_rows.meaning: Record total harmonic distortion, crest factor, phase angle and power factor with the relevant electrical subject.
new_rows.loss: Active and reactive power alone do not supply the waveform quality measures.

new_rows.label: Absolute atmospheric humidity by mass per volume
new_rows.meaning: Record absolute humidity in grams per cubic metre independently from relative humidity in percent.
new_rows.loss: Relative humidity does not provide vapour mass per unit volume without additional state information.

new_rows.label: Coolant supply and return temperatures, pressures and heat removal
new_rows.meaning: Identify the supply and return legs of the same cooling interface and preserve the heat-removal quantity.
new_rows.loss: A water temperature does not identify a supply/return pair, establish the coolant medium, or quantify heat removed.

new_rows.label: Coolant formulation and thermophysical properties
new_rows.meaning: Describe the coolant, additive concentration, density and specific heat for thermal calculations.
new_rows.loss: A water specific-gravity reading is not a coolant formulation or heat capacity.

new_rows.label: Leak detection state, response severity and delay
new_rows.meaning: Keep sensor detection state separate from the configured reaction at warning and critical severity and its delay.
new_rows.loss: An alert lifecycle does not identify the leak detector’s configured physical response.

new_rows.label: Cooling airflow and pressure differential across equipment
new_rows.meaning: Record volumetric airflow and equipment pressure drop with their units and physical boundary.
new_rows.loss: Wind speed and direction do not identify the volume moving through an enclosure or pressure drop across it.

new_rows.label: Permitted settings application times and maintenance window
new_rows.meaning: Separate when a change can be applied, the chosen maintenance window, and the recorded application time.
new_rows.loss: A planned or online representation does not state the eligible maintenance window or when application took effect.

new_rows.label: Log overflow count and first and last overflow times
new_rows.meaning: Record evidence that entries were lost to overflow, its count and time bounds together with log retention policy.
new_rows.loss: A requested retrieval window alone cannot reveal a gap caused by overflow.

new_rows.label: Subscription delivery retry policy, backup destinations and heartbeat
new_rows.meaning: Preserve how the publisher handles delivery failure, configured alternate destinations and the heartbeat policy.
new_rows.loss: A cancellation or response schema does not establish retries, failover recipients or heartbeat delivery.

new_rows.label: Filter differential pressure, actual service hours and rated service life
new_rows.meaning: Tie filter pressure drop, service hours, rating and service date to the particular replaceable filter.
new_rows.loss: Lifetime powered duration does not identify a filter service interval or the pressure drop used to assess that filter.

new_rows.label: Manufacturer-declared chassis dimensions and mass
new_rows.meaning: Retain the manufacturer’s overall enclosure dimensions in millimetres and published mass in kilograms, attached to the chassis.
new_rows.loss: A card mechanical profile or mating constraint does not specify the whole enclosure’s dimensions and mass.

new_rows.label: Replacement part number versus installed assembly part number
new_rows.meaning: Record the part number of the installed assembly separately from the part number used to order its replacement.
new_rows.loss: One commercial product identifier does not tell a maintainer whether it names the installed assembly or the service spare.

new_rows.label: Significant digits versus percent and absolute accuracy of a reading
new_rows.meaning: Preserve the number of significant digits, percentage accuracy and absolute accuracy in the reading units as distinct qualifiers.
new_rows.loss: A numeric uncertainty alone neither expresses resolution in significant digits nor identifies whether the accuracy value is relative or absolute.

new_rows.label: Metric aggregation function, time scope and collection duration
new_rows.meaning: State the statistical function, scope in time and duration governing a value in a report.
new_rows.loss: A reporting interval schedules delivery; it does not describe the function or window used to calculate the reported value.

new_rows.label: Composition sharing capability, permission and current use
new_rows.meaning: Keep capability for sharing, enabled policy, current compositions and maximum compositions with the particular resource block.
new_rows.loss: Allowed component types and current membership do not specify how many compositions may share a block or whether sharing was enabled.

new_rows.label: Automation-node motion axis and commanded movement profile
new_rows.meaning: Describe the node’s primary axis and the motion profile used, such as a trapezoidal profile or S-curve.
new_rows.loss: A measured angular velocity does not define the axis and acceleration profile selected by the node.

new_rows.label: Ordered corrective step with identified target and retry policy
new_rows.meaning: Capture which component and corrective action a resolution step concerns, its priority and its allowed retries.
new_rows.loss: A suggested corrective action does not by itself identify a structured target, retry count or retry interval.

new_rows.label: Separately identified cooling and electrical suppliers for managed equipment
new_rows.meaning: Represent electrical and cooling dependencies separately, including whether a containing chassis supplies or manages the function.
new_rows.loss: A connection to a power source cannot express the distinct cooling dependency or thermal-management inheritance.

RF-MANAGER-ENDPOINTS.OSUSR: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — OSUS-R distinguishes a managed asset, core and plug-in. It does not thereby say which enclosure houses the controller or which other enclosures it manages. [Earlier master row 19]

RF-SENSOR-SUBJECT.OSUSR: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — OSUS-R identifies an optional sensor within a managed asset. That selector alone does not identify the equipment served by an excerpt or its source resource. [Earlier master row 529]

RF-READING-ORIGIN.PADIM: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — PA-DIM distinguishes unsimulated and substituted process values. That substitution has different semantics from a reading reported by another source. [Earlier master row 484]

RF-CONTROL-DEADBAND.PADIM: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — The earlier PA-DIM row relates the target and readback. That record does not establish a deadband or activation delay. [Earlier master row 500]

RF-THRESHOLD-HYSTERESIS.ISA: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — The ISA comparison supports a publication threshold. It does not establish both the activation dwell and the return hysteresis for this condition. [Earlier master row 89]

RF-LOCAL-ROLLUP.OpenGroupSOSA: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — The earlier SOSA comparison concerns reported health and faults. It does not establish the Redfish distinction between resource-only health and rolled-up health. [Earlier master row 395]

RF-APPLY-WINDOW.OPC: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — OPC UA Devices distinguishes planned and online parameters. The prior comparison alone does not establish the scheduling window for application. [Earlier master row 469]

RF-DELIVERY-RECOVERY.WoT: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — The Web of Things comparison describes subscription, cancellation and response schemas. Delivery retry and failover require extra evidence. [Earlier master row 519]

RF-BATTERY-E-RATE.OSUSR: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — OSUS-R distinguishes active/reactive electrical quantities. The earlier comparison does not supply the rated watt-hour denominator. [Earlier master row 534]

RF-COOLANT-PAIR.OSUSR: RELATED PRIOR EVIDENCE — OSUS-R has a water-temperature quantity. That single quantity does not identify the two legs of a cooling circuit or the removed heat. [Earlier master row 546]

classification_policy: Direct and partial indicate degree of correspondence within the stated scope. Common and specialized fills indicate likely reusability. Related and scoped negatives are white. Unresolved quantity references are lavender. The nine case holds require installation evidence. A row count is not a ranking of foundational value.
scope_decision: Recommend bounded partial. All families have a documented route. Field matches and additions use member-level evidence. Inventory-only entries confer no match or absence conclusion. Retain RF-Q1 through RF-Q3.
